tīraṇa.p: [Tīra+yu] (na,thī) CL=7 (1) (A) Made a decision. (B) Concentration and contemplation. (2) (A) It is a cause of making a decision. (Wisdom) which is the cause of concentration and contemplation.

tīraṇapariññā.p: [Tīraṇa+pariññā] (thī) CL=7 (1) (A) It can be distinguished and known by concentration and contemplation. (B) It knows clearly by making a decision. (2) (A) It is a cause of knowing clearly by concentration and contemplation. (B) (Wisdom) that is a cause of knowing clearly by concentration and contemplation.
